voices.text: An empty corridor. Or the start of a mystery? Meet Yuvo.

Start with an idea: a woman can talk to abandoned buildings. Their memories are incomplete. Gemini plans the research. Parallel searches nearby stories and audience reactions, so you’re building on evidence.
Eleven sources. One useful direction: let the building’s damage shape what it remembers. Open the research behind the idea. Then make your own creative decision.

Now, agentic video understanding. Attach a real cut. Gemini checks the frames against your premise. It sees the abandoned setting, but catches the missing protagonist. Click a timestamp. See exactly what it means.

Let’s iterate. We add a deadline and two conflicting memories to the same footage. Upload the new cut. Gemini compares both videos. It spots the new text, and tells us what still needs work: show the woman interacting with the building. That’s a specific shot we can make next.
Idea. Evidence. Cut. A clear next move. Powered by Gemini, Parallel, and Google Cloud Run. Yuvo. Big idea. Better story.
